name: Will
customDesc: The sovereign overlord, whose mere whisper commands the tides of fate and whose iron will binds the very foundations of the realm.

name: Parker
customDesc: Master of whispers and the silent orchestrator of the throne's absolute power. He sees all that the light touches, and all that it does not.

name: Darcy
customDesc: The blood-soaked vanguard of the King's wrath. A relentless tactician whose enchanted blade has tasted the ruin of a thousand empires.

name: Harrison
customDesc: The grand architect of prosperity. He bends the very earth to his will, forging unstoppable empires from raw stone and boundless ambition.

name: Thomas
customDesc: The iron-fisted warden of the harvest and the law. He reaps both the golden wheat and the souls of the guilty with equal, merciless judgment.

name: Nate
customDesc: An enigmatic alchemist dancing on the razor's edge of life and death, brewing volatile elixirs that could either grant immortality or shatter the mind.

name: Max
customDesc: The golden heir to the throne, bearing the crushing, inescapable weight of a legacy forged in blood and destined to one day eclipse the stars.

name: Alex
customDesc: A humble soul bound to the dirt, yet harboring the burning, unyielding spirit of a thousand ancestors in the eternal shadow of the crown.

name: Nicky
customDesc: An unsung hero of the cobblestones, whose relentless daily toil weaves the very fabric of the kingdom's glorious and unending tapestry.

name: Poppy
customDesc: A fiercely loyal resident whose unwavering devotion to the realm burns brighter than the hottest forge. A true, unstoppable pillar of the kingdom's grand destiny.
